passive.name: Mana Surge
passive.desc: Xerath's basic attacks periodically restore Mana. Whenever Xerath kills a unit, this cooldown is reduced.

spells.name: Arcanopulse
spells.desc: Fires a long-range beam of energy, dealing magic damage to all targets hit.

spells.name: Eye of Destruction
spells.desc: Calls down a barrage of arcane energy, slowing and dealing magic damage to all enemies in an area. Targets in the middle receive additional damage and a stronger slow.

spells.name: Shocking Orb
spells.desc: Deals magic damage to an enemy and stuns them.

spells.name: Rite of the Arcane
spells.desc: Xerath immobilizes himself and gains numerous long-range barrages.
